initialFindings.finding: Hanging hoses and end fittings were spatially separated in the rendered previews.
The upper grip was detached from its handle.

sourceCorrections: Aligned the exhaust capture rail's hanging cylinder and nozzle hanger vertically below the trolley.
Moved the retractable reel hose and coupler to meet below the reel drum.
Moved the bay washdown hose to run from the drum to the spray grip.
Joined the exhaust capture nozzle grip to the cross-handle.
result: The revised preview sheet shows each hose connected to its reel or nozzle. Station fixtures remain visibly distinct at catalog-preview scale.
